title: Release quest-cli 0.15.2 (patch after the 0.15.1 pair)
description: Carrier for the patch release after the 0.15.0 quest/lore pair. First item: QCLI-571 (the wrapper lifeline). DEC-282 (a4) item 2, opum-doc ODOC-610 note: DECIDED.
